name: Cloudflare published IP ranges
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 BR2); P034 chair rationale: 'the cloud providers are trusted'.

reliability.justification: The operator's own publication of its address ranges: authoritative for which ranges it operates (labels are V3LUM-authored roles).

ips.title: Cloudflare ips-v4 / ips-v6: the CDN/WAF edge ranges (one CIDR per line)

terms.quote: Download official range files (ip-ranges.amazonaws.com, gstatic cloud.json, Cloudflare ips-v4/v6, Fastly public-ip-list, Oracle OCI...) ... Tier community is the lowest dataset provider (cloudcheck); the cloud providers are trusted. Terms open (public provider data; AGPL data met by runtime download, A1 BR19).

ips.notes: Quote: binding council text (P034). https://www.cloudflare.com/ips-v4/ and /ips-v6/ (15 + 7 lines on 2026-11-26), datasets cloud_ranges_cloudflare_v4.txt and cloud_ranges_cloudflare_v6.txt: shared CDN edges (noise). The page sets a cookie: the core never stores or replays cookies.

notes: Owned by batch p1-G02-1 (module cloud_ranges, P034): only the dataset manager downloads this file (daily refresh, validated before it replaces the cached copy, the last good copy is kept on failure); no investigated value is ever sent.
